She wears a hooded gray robe with a darker waist sash, an ankle-length robe skirt with a slightly darker hem, and goes barefoot with simple ankle wraps. Pale skin, dark hair just visible under the hood, a clearly readable young face in profile with a visible eye, brow, nose and mouth. Realistic child body proportions, about 5.5 head-heights tall, matching the reference turnaround exactly in design, coloring and proportions. Rendered as a single cohesive hand-painted illustration with soft painterly brushwork and visible brush texture, in a muted earthy palette (grays, browns, warm skin tones), NOT a flat vector cutout, in the painted-storybook register of games like Hollow Knight or GRIS. A mid-air fall in progress, not a jump, not a static floating pose, with no ground, floor, or ledge anywhere in the image. Full body visible from the top of the hood to the soles of both bare feet, and both hands, entirely inside the canvas with generous empty margin on every side so nothing is cropped.
